items.title: Publish a unified, versioned data dashboard
items.description: Reconcile MoRTH, police, health and transport records where feasible; publish revisions, definitions, reporting coverage, 30-day fatality rules, serious-injury definitions and downloadable data.

items.title: Target proven risk factors
items.description: Prioritize speed management, universal helmet use including pillion riders, seat-belt use in all seats, impaired-driving enforcement and safe crossing access around schools, transit and markets.

items.title: Treat high-risk locations
items.description: Use transparent criteria to select black spots, junctions and corridors; publish before/after engineering audits and outcome measures.

items.title: Set up independent evaluation
items.description: Every major pilot should state its theory of change, baseline, comparison strategy, equity safeguards and outcome indicators before launch.

items.title: Strengthen emergency response
items.description: Map ambulance coverage and trauma capacity against high-fatality corridors; measure response times and survival, not just vehicles deployed.

items.title: Make safe speeds a network policy
items.description: Define road classes, speed-limit rules and design standards that account for pedestrians and two-wheelers; scale proven camera systems with due process.

items.title: Deliver safe-system street design
items.description: Require safety audits for new construction and major upgrades, prioritize retrofits on existing roads, and fund footpaths and crossings as core road infrastructure.

items.title: Improve vehicle and fleet safety
items.description: Use procurement, inspection and fleet rules to lift safety for buses, trucks, taxis and commercial two-wheelers; publish compliance outcomes.

items.title: Build state accountability
items.description: Set state targets, annual budgets and district dashboards; link technical support to measurable delivery while accounting for exposure and reporting quality.

items.title: Use novice-driver protections
items.description: Pilot staged licensing and supervision where administrative capacity exists; evaluate effects and access barriers before broader rollout.

items.title: Embed the Safe System
items.description: Embed a Vision Zero / Safe System principle in national and state transport planning: deaths and serious injuries are preventable and the system must account for human vulnerability.

items.title: Align land use and mobility
items.description: Align land use, public transport, walking, cycling and road design to reduce exposure to high-speed conflict.

items.title: Continue evaluation
items.description: Continue longitudinal evaluation and update interventions as evidence and travel patterns change.
